author: Roxana Naranjo Estrada

evidenceBasis.originalSource: Read-only inspection of the current private frontend and backend source. Private repository contents and deployment configuration are not included in this record.
evidenceBasis.publicAdaptation: Six selected main-journey views adapted from real FlowIPS interface components inside the portfolio, with local TypeScript transport, synthetic state, and a guided walkthrough. This is not the entire original application. Transport-related confirmation wording is adapted to describe local simulation and shared state while original dictionaries remain intact.
evidenceBasis.captures: Three authentic interface captures from the documented 2 October 2026 gallery, using synthetic data. These are independent examples, not one continuous encounter.
